scenes.summary: Michael Thompson arrives at the bus station carrying a brown folder containing the property deed. His mother calls to confirm he has it and reminds him that Uncle Robert needs to see it before tomorrow. Michael places the folder back in his backpack.
scenes.source_text:
Title: The Missing Deed

Scene 1 – Bus Station

MICHAEL THOMPSON (29) gets off a bus carrying a brown folder.

His mother calls.

MOTHER
Did you bring the property deed?

MICHAEL
It's right here.

MOTHER
Good. Uncle Robert needs to see it before tomorrow.

Michael places the folder back in his backpack.

state_changes.note: Michael places the folder back in his backpack.

state_changes.item: Uncle Robert needs to see the property deed before tomorrow

knows: Uncle Robert needs to see the property deed before tomorrow

scenes.summary: Michael arrives home to find his father John Thompson at the dining table with a brown folder. They discuss a dispute over farm ownership. Later, Uncle Robert arrives and a heated family meeting occurs around the table. The brown folder is central to the discussion and is slid onto a chair by Michael. After the argument ends, Michael picks up the folder and leaves the room.
scenes.source_text:
Scene 2 – Family House

Michael arrives home.

His father JOHN THOMPSON sits at the dining table.

The brown folder is placed in the center.

JOHN
Your uncle thinks part of the farm belongs to him.

MICHAEL
What does the deed say?

JOHN
That's what we're trying to find out.

Michael opens the folder and looks through several documents.

That evening, UNCLE ROBERT arrives and a family meeting takes place around the table.

Michael slides the folder onto the chair beside him.

Robert argues with John.

ROBERT
Those documents were hidden for years.

JOHN
Because they weren't relevant.

The argument grows louder.

The folder remains on the chair near Michael.

When the meeting ends, Michael picks it up and leaves the room.

knows: Uncle Robert needs to see the property deed before tomorrow

scenes.summary: The lawyer examines documents and finds several pages missing. John reacts by hitting his arm on the desk, causing a cut. The lawyer gives John a bandage which he uses to wrap the wound. The folder remains on the desk.
scenes.source_text:
Scene 3 – Lawyer Office

The next morning.

The lawyer examines the documents.

John wears a gray jacket.

LAWYER
Several pages are missing.

Everyone looks shocked.

John stands suddenly and hits his arm against a desk.

A cut appears on his forearm.

The lawyer hands him a bandage.

John wraps the wound.

The folder remains on the desk.

scenes.summary: Michael and Robert talk privately at the county fair. Michael accidentally drops a brown folder which falls beneath a food stall. Robert searches and retrieves the folder, warning Michael that he almost lost the most important thing. Michael laughs.
scenes.dramatic_purpose: To show the importance of the brown folder and the relationship dynamic between Michael and Robert.
scenes.source_text:
Scene 4 – County Fair

Michael and Robert talk privately.

The brown folder slips from Michael's hands.

It falls beneath a food stall.

After searching, Robert retrieves it.

ROBERT
You almost lost the most important thing here.

Michael laughs.

scenes.summary: John enters wearing a blue jacket. The bandage he had is gone and the folder is missing. Michael asks about the deed, but John is confused. Robert enters carrying photocopies and says he found the missing pages. Michael looks around and notes the original folder is nowhere to be found.
scenes.source_text:
Scene 5 – Family House (Next Morning)

John enters.

He now wears a blue jacket.

The bandage is gone.

The folder is missing.

MICHAEL
Where's the deed?

JOHN
What deed?

Everyone looks confused.

Robert enters carrying photocopies.

ROBERT
I found the missing pages.

Michael looks around.

The original folder is nowhere to be found.
